notes.title: The 3dSen emulator turning NES games into 3D voxel dioramas 1.0 is out now - we have keys to give away
notes.notes:
It took around 10 years to make it fully happen but the 3dSen emulator is out now with the 1.0 release for both the PC and VR releases.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/the-3dsen-emulator-turning-nes-games-into-3d-voxel-dioramas-1-0-is-out-now-we-have-keys-to-give-away/

notes.title: The emulator that lets you play NES games in 3D has left early access on Steam
notes.notes: This is probably more impressive to those of you who grew up with a NES, but even I, a Zelda-hating grouch, think it's kind of neat to see Ninja Gaiden in voxels instead of pixels, and with a camera you can move around... Read more.

notes.title: 🚀 3dSen PC v1.0 is Here – A Dream 10 Years in the Making
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="_y2AE-kWtjM;full"][/previewyoutube][p]I can’t believe I’m writing this… but here we are.[/p][p]After [b]over 10 years of solo development[/b] — countless late nights, mysterious bugs, painful rewrites, and yes, constant back pain —
[b]3dSen PC \[VR] has officially exited Early Access![/b] 🎉[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💡 It All Started With a Crazy Idea[/h3][quote][p][i]"What if you could play classic NES games — not just emulated — but reimagined, rebuilt, and experienced in full 3D?"[/i][/p][/quote][p]Not just parallax. Not just layers.
But [b]true 3D environments[/b], carefully reconstructed from 2D sprites, while keeping the gameplay you know and love.[/p][p]That idea turned into an obsession — one game, one profile, one breakthrough at a time.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ A Journey Fueled by Curiosity, Stubbornness, and Love for the Craft[/h3][list][*][p]Supporting [b]both VR and flat-screen PC[/b] meant solving everything twice — and discovering twice the magic.[/p][/*][*][p]I even experimented with futuristic gear like the [b]Looking Glass holographic display[/b], just to see how far I could push it.[/p][/*][*][p]I've supported [b]Windows, Linux, and macOS[/b] from the start — and still do.
While others dropped platforms, I stuck with them because [b]everyone deserves access[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Getting rollback, rewind, and fast-forward working on top of a 3D NES engine[/b] was an [i]interesting[/i] challenge… but totally worth it.[/p][/*][*][p]Shifting from [b]itch.io to Steam[/b] opened new doors — and brought in so many of you reading this now.[/p][/*][/list][p]But honestly?[/p][p]The biggest fuel was always [b]you[/b] — the community.
Your feedback, bug reports, modding tips, and even your criticism kept me going when things got hard.[/p][p]And now, thanks to the [b]3dSenMaker tool[/b], you're helping take it even further by crafting your own [b]handmade 3D profiles[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 What’s in 3dSen PC \[VR] v1.0?[/h3][p]Over [b]100 iconic NES games[/b], reimagined in fully dynamic 3D:[/p][quote][p]🕹️ Fast-paced platformers
🧙‍♂️ Epic RPGs
🥊 Beat 'em ups
🧩 Puzzlers
💎 Obscure hidden gems[/p][/quote][p]Each of the 100 built-in profiles is [b]handcrafted[/b].
And so are the many fantastic community-made ones — lovingly built and shared using 3dSenMaker.[/p][p]🧩 [b]Explore community-made profiles here:[/b]
👉 [url="https://itch.io/board/872690/profile-repository"]itch.io Community Profile Repository[/url][/p][p]🎬 [b][url="https://youtu.be/_y2AE-kWtjM"]Watch the v1.0 Launch Trailer[/url][/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧠 Modern Features, Built for Real Play[/h3][list][*][p]⚡ [b]Quick Save / Load[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⏪ [b]Rollback & Rewind[/b][/p][/*][*][p]⏩ [b]Fast-Forward[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🎥 [b]Custom Camera Zoom & Rotation[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔫 [b]Zapper Light Gun Support[/b][/p][/*][*][p]✋ [b]Motion Gesture Gameplay[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🖥️ [b]Native Windows, Linux, and macOS support[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎉 40% OFF Launch Discount – Limited Time Only![/h3][p]To celebrate this milestone,
[b]3dSen PC \[VR] is 40% OFF for a limited time[/b]!
If you’ve been waiting to jump in — now’s your chance.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This isn’t just a version number.
It’s the result of [b]10 years of exploration, perseverance[/b],
and belief in something [b]weird, personal, and wonderful[/b].[/p][p][b]Thank you for being a part of this journey.[/b]
Let’s keep pushing the boundaries of retro gaming — together.[/p][p]— Truc
[i]Geod Studio[/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="_MBHj9IGZgE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: "Rockman Special 3D Edition" Profile
notes.notes:
I would like to inform you all about the release of "Rockman Special 3D Edition" profile from Dr. Volt Alessandro Arcade and CROOT_ROM. 
Their style and taste are different to me. There are more depths everywhere in their profile compared to the built-in one and especially every character becomes 3D.
Just check this profile out:
https://itch.io/t/1024726/mega-man-3d
Let download/import the profile,  give it a try and let us know which one you prefer :)

As a side node:  Dr. Volt Alessandro Arcade is also working to create profiles for the rest of MegaMan/RockMan series (4,5,6). 
MegaMan 4 seems already done here and can be played right now: 
https://itch.io/t/964182/project-mega-man-4
It's very interessting - his style and approach. 

Merry Christmas everyone!

notes.title: v0.9.3 release
notes.notes:
- Functionality: new camera control algorithm which will make sure that the game world is always at the view center no matter how players manipulate the camera. Much better viewing experience especially for top down games.

- Profile:
 + New profiles: Felix the Cat, Gradius, Burger Time
 + Improvement: new 3D Battle Scene for Final Fantasy
 + Fix bugs: 
  * Zelda 2: Fix bugs for Zelda 2 randomizer versions of game
  * Simon Quest: wrong layer of church curtains 
  * DrMario: scores weren't displayed in 2 player modes
  * Dragon Warrior I: dialog is invisible in default camera position
  * Final Fantasy : some minor bugs

- Last but not least currently many games profile are being dead blocked because I can not play through the game. If you can and want to offer this kind of help, please contact me, the best way is via Discord server at https://discord.gg/2ZP6mRq

notes.title: Steam Award Nomination Request
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

Thank you very much for the support so far.  This is the motivation for me to keep working and adding support for more games. Your enjoyment of 3dSen is my happiness. 

I don't have any hope or something like that but think it's fun to ask. 

So you if want to give additional support for 3dSen, you could give the project a vote in the Steam Award Nomination.
Or simply drop a review :)

Thank you,
Geod

notes.title: 3dSen PC release date : 19 June 2020
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,
I'm very happy and proud to announce that 3dSen PC will be EA released on Steam on 19 June 2020.
It will mark 5 years since i started working on this project and 4 years since the first ever build was released! I just can't wait for that day to come :)
